desc: Implement median-of-transformed-values solution: K = number of 1s, t[j] = p[j] - j, answer = sum |t[j] - median|; read N,S from stdin, print answer.
Test the implementation on all three provided samples and confirm outputs 3, 0, 7.
Sanity-check edge cases: already-contiguous 1s (answer 0), single 1 (answer 0), all 1s at both ends.
Confirm O(N) performance and large-value safety (N up to 5e5, answer up to ~O(N^2)).
